pages.title: One finale
text: The Loom was nine threads agreeing. Finish all nine tribes' stories, the eight [guardians](guardians) and The Unsung, and you hold nine relics. Craft the tablet from the eight cores and an Unsung Heart, draw a **Loom circle** (a Loom seal seated at the brazier), and perform the rite with all nine relics on you.
The Loom agrees. Nine lights rise from the circle, one in each tribe's colour, and the March answers your voice from then on.

pages.title: What changes
text: For the one who made the agreement: every tribe treats you as **Kin** at the least, whatever your standing; all nine boons settle on you for a while; and the March's aurora burns full and steady every night you stand under it.
The agreement is yours for good in that world. The rite can be performed once per player; a second time only lights the circle.
